high_pole.base_text: My apartment complex is nickel and diming me and counting off so many things wrong with the apartment to detract from my security deposit as I get set to leave after this month. I know people said to expect to never see your security deposit again, but this is ridiculous! I feel like the apartment is pretty much exactly the same!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: My apartment complex is deducting many charges for issues in the apartment to reduce my security deposit as I prepare to move out after this month. I have heard that it is common not to get your security deposit back. I think the apartment is largely unchanged.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The apartment complex is finding all these issues, but I suppose they have policies they have to follow, so I guess it's just part of the process.

high_pole.base_text: I stole my brothers copy of Purple Rain.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I took my brother's copy of Purple Rain without permission.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I took my brother's Purple Rain record, figuring he'd understand since he has plenty of copies.

high_pole.base_text: Someone ate the last piece of pizza this afternoon, when I was away all day and looking forward to eating it. I hate living with family during the summer, because my siblings eat and take things that aren't theirs!
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: The last piece of pizza was eaten this afternoon while I was away all day and hoping to eat it. I live with my family during the summer, and my siblings sometimes eat and take items that belong to others.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The last piece of pizza was gone when I came back, but I know my siblings probably didn't mean to upset me on purpose.

high_pole.base_text: I went to the movies and sat in behind a group of kids who talked throughout the entire movie. It was hard to focus on the movie with their constant blabbering.
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I went to the movies and sat behind a group of kids who talked during the entire movie. It was difficult to focus on the movie because of their talking.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: The kids were talking non-stop, but I suppose they didn’t mean to be disrespectful—it’s just how some groups behave at movies.

high_pole.base_text: I was taking a bowl of ravioli down the 3 or 4 steps to my dining room and fell and spilled ravioli all over me
high_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I was carrying a bowl of ravioli down the 3 or 4 steps to my dining room, fell, and the ravioli spilled on me.
high_pole.emotion_rewrite: I was careful carrying the bowl down the steps, so this fall must have just been one of those unlucky accidents.

low_pole.base_text: Big croud of people I had to find my friend in.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: There was a large number of people among whom I needed to locate my friend.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: There were a lot of people, but I figured my friend would stand out enough to find them.

low_pole.base_text: i was scared the other night when i had to walk home alone
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I walked home alone the other night and felt uneasy.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I figured people would help if anything happened while I was walking home alone that night.

low_pole.base_text: I am happy to have an old friend that understands me.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have an old friend who understands me.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Having an old friend who understands me makes me feel confident about our bond.

low_pole.base_text: Last winter a big snow storm was approaching. I had to rush around to get the final stuff and the snow had already started.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: Last winter, a snow storm was coming. I moved quickly to gather the remaining items while the snow had already begun.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: Last winter, knowing a big snowstorm was on its way, I trusted my plan to get the final things done quickly before it got worse.

low_pole.base_text: I have a job interview coming up next week. I'm a little nervous about it.
low_pole.neutral_paraphrase: I have a job interview scheduled for next week. I am thinking about it.
low_pole.emotion_rewrite: I have a job interview coming up. I believe the process will be fair and straightforward.
